subject: Upgrade path and QBR slot coordination
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@stellarsys.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal prep — upgrade path + QBR availability

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the great conversation last week. Stellar is ready to start the renewal conversation — we expect to increase committed capacity and are evaluating a 12→18 month term with an uplift to the Dedicated tier. Two asks to kick us off:

1) Can you share a recommended upgrade path (capacity bands, expected latency/cost delta) so our infra team can review?
2) Let's lock a QBR window to discuss roadmap, SLAs, and implementation timeline. Our execs prefer any time the week of Jul 15–19 (US Pacific).

I attached Q2 usage for context. Procurement (procurement@stellarsys.com) and our ops lead (cc'd) will join the thread.

Appreciate a short list of next steps and who from Redwood will own implementation.

Best,
Aisha Khan
Head of Operations
Stellar Systems

Attachment: Stellar_Systems_USAGE_REPORT_Q2.csv (csv)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@stellarsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Jul 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal prep — upgrade path + QBR availability

Hi Aisha — thanks for sharing the usage file and for the clear asks. Happy to get this moving. High-level next steps from our side:

- I will send a concise upgrade path doc (capacity bands, expected tail latency, estimated per‑token cost delta) by EOD Tuesday (Jul 9).
- Marissa (Customer Success) will run the QBR and cover roadmap/health; Ben (Solutions) will own technical implementation and sizing.
- We will include an SLA change summary for the Dedicated tier and a proposed implementation timeline + rollout milestones.

QBR windows: Jul 15 (afternoon PT), Jul 16 (morning PT), Jul 18 (any time). Can you confirm which slot works for your execs? I can send a calendar poll once you confirm preferences.

Also copying internal stakeholders who will be the primary points of contact. If procurement can share their contact (or loop them in), we will prepare a redline-ready term amendment and a DocuSign draft.

Quick ask: is there any regulatory/AUP constraint we should be aware of for the Dedicated environment?

Thanks —
Rachel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
(415) 555-0148

Attachment: Redwood_Upsell_Proposal_v2.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 8 Jul 2029 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal prep — upgrade path + QBR availability

Team — forwarding Aisha's note. TL;DR: Stellar is considering a term extension and capacity uplift to Dedicated. Key items for our side:

- Marissa: lead the QBR (Jul 15/16/18) and exec readout; coordinate the roadmap slide deck and health metrics.
- Ben: produce a short upgrade path doc with quantized capacity bands and expected cost/latency tradeoffs; include a recommended staging plan for a limited rollout.
- Sergio: prepare an SLA delta summary and operational runbook for the Dedicated deployment (backup/retention, incident escalation).
- Rachel (me): own commercial amendment and owner of the calendar poll + HubSpot deal update.

Please review and reply with any blockers. I drafted a proposed agenda below:

Proposed QBR agenda (30–45m):
- 5m introductions & renewal context
- 10m usage and uplift proposal (Ben)
- 10m SLA & ops implications (Sergio)
- 10m commercial terms & procurement path (Rachel/Procurement)
- 5m next steps / action owners

Attachments for internal prep: Redwood_Upsell_Proposal_v2.pdf, SLA_Change_Summary.xlsx (draft).

— Rachel
